mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE tree AS ( SELECT id, id AS root_id FROM comment WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND status = 1 AND (parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id = 0) UNION ALL SELECT c.id, t.root_id FROM comment c INNER JOIN tree t ON c.parent_id = t.id AND c.status = 1 ), reply_counts AS ( SELECT root_id, COUNT(*) - 1 AS reply_count FROM tree GROUP BY root_id ) SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.topic_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.content, c.likes_count, c.status, c.create_time, c.update_time, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), CONCAT('用户', u.id)) AS user_name, u.avatar AS user_avatar, COALESCE(c.location, '') AS location, COALESCE(rc.reply_count, 0) AS reply_count FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN reply_counts rc ON c.id = rc.root_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.status = 1 AND (c.parent_id IS NULL OR c.parent_id = 0) ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.topic_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.content, c.likes_count, c.status, c.create_time, c.update_time, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), CONCAT('用户', u.id)) as user_name, u.avatar as user_avatar, COALESCE(c.location, '') as location FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.parent_id = #{commentId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time ASC
